en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are fields, farm buildings, and industrial facilities with tall brick chimneys. A river and a stone bridge can be seen near textile‑factory‑like buildings. The middle of the image shows a dense cluster of townhouses and a church tower, and on a slight rise stands a castle‑like complex. At the top left of the image, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a cursive font, indicating the town's name.
